source_instructions: - PDFScoreBar: `app/` of the portable folder is the complete application source; the builder (`tools/windows_portable/*`, `requirements-cu126.txt`, `assets.json`) at `builder_source_commit` is in `source/pdfscorebar-builder-<commit>.tar.gz`.

- HOMR (AGPL-3.0): `source/homr-457e7c6518a10ba755db2e60883419e56c4d7369.tar.gz` (upstream commit) plus `app/docker/patch_homr_onnx_provider.py` (modification, applied at build time) and `app/docker/init_homr_segnet.py` (model initialization).
- PyMuPDF / MuPDF (AGPL-3.0): `source/pymupdf-1.26.4.tar.gz` and `source/mupdf-1.26.7-source.tar.gz` (the MuPDF release pinned by PyMuPDF 1.26.4).
- No LGPL binary is shipped: OpenCV's FFmpeg plugins are removed at build time and TinyCC comes with triton-windows, which the recipient installs from PyPI.
- All other Python packages are unmodified releases from PyPI / download.pytorch.org at the versions in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
